scope: Isolated two-bank immutable result snapshots; original native-v3 untouched

memory.copy_cycles: 258 from accepted CLAIM with no CPU alias burst active;256 storedwords, explicit mux/BRAM PRIME

mmio_words.0x0e: Read raw LOAD generation; increments after every successful LOAD independently of snapshots
mmio_words.0x0f: Write raw generation token to attempt nonblocking CLAIM and background copy

0x10.access: Read latched result of most recent CLAIM, remains until next CLAIM/reset

bits.2: rejected: same generation already has an outstanding bank
bits.4: rejected: result invalid, producer active, token mismatch, count not1..32, or simultaneous LOAD completion

status_bits.9: Raw result copy reservation active; START must wait for this only
status_bits.10: Sticky GPU import/release fault or rejected START while copying; ordinary CLAIM rejection never sets it

gpu_commands: Unchanged0x5D/0x5E/0x5F; token is full32-bit raw LOAD generation and uniquely selects a nonfree bank; duplicate CLAIM is rejected
claim_policy: If accepted, source remains protected until all256words captured; CPU alias in flight drains first. If rejected, application uses ordinary CPU payload immediately and queues no RELEASE. Busy/duplicate/no-free is expected fallback, not permanent disable.
copy_lifetime: Raw producer protection ends after final snapshot write, independently of command consumption. New LOAD may overlap old snapshot imports and rasterization.
gpu_lifetime: FILLING-token request waits for ready; READY request grants synchronous snapshot read port. Wrong token/source is error. ReadDone releases read port only; orderedRELEASE frees bank after all imports.
release_policy: Only matching READY bank without same-bank GPU read/request is freed; stale/premature release sets stickyerror and leaves bank intact
reset: Consumer reset discards banks/copier/readowner/claimresult/error but not raw DMA or raw generation; fabricreset additionally resetsgeneration
software: Base on BRAM3 complete-batch publication; no GPU-idle admission. Pollcopybit9 before raw START, but neverwaitforbankfree. Readclaimresultbit0 after everyattempt.
